name: L293D Dual H-Bridge Motor Driver IC
description: 16-pin dual-channel H-bridge driver integrated circuit delivering up to 600mA per channel with internal flyback clamping diodes.
realWorldAnalogy: 16-pin dual-channel H-bridge driver integrated circuit delivering up to 600mA per channel with internal flyback clamping diodes.

hazards: IC can become hot when driving continuous high motor currents

wiringGuidance: Connect pin 16 (VCC1) to Arduino 5V for logic, pin 8 (VCC2) to motor battery supply (6-9V), pins 4, 5, 12, 13 to common GND.
commonMistakes: Forgetting to connect both battery GND and Arduino GND together.
Leaving EN1 (pin 1) low or floating, which disables the motor outputs.

miniExperiment.title: Forward & Reverse DC Motor Spin
miniExperiment.circuit: Pin 1 (EN) to 5V, Pin 2 (1A) to Pin 4, Pin 7 (2A) to Pin 5, Pin 3 & 6 to Motor terminals.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: The DC motor spins forward for 2 seconds, pauses, then reverses direction for 2 seconds.
